WITH LIST(CATE, INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, INPT_RCP_DT, AUTH, AI_INPT_AUT_CD, USER_ID, AI_INPT_USER_NM, COUNT_ENO, TOTAL_TIME, AVG_TIME, AVGE, INPT_MST_SRNO) AS ( SELECT M.CATE , M.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , M.INPT_RCP_DT , CASE WHEN U.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '01' THEN '심사자' WHEN U.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '02' THEN '결재자' ELSE 'QA 담당자' END AS AUTH , U.AI_INPT_AUT_CD , U.AI_INPT_USER_ENO AS USER_ID , U.AI_INPT_USER_NM , COUNT(DISTINCT TM.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO) AS COUNT_ENO , TM.PRO_TIME AS TOTAL_TIME , TO_NUMBER(TM.PRO_TIME) / COUNT(DISTINCT TM.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO) AS AVG_TIME , '' AS AVGE , M.INPT_MST_SRNO FROM( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO, INPT_RCP_DT, INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, CATE, AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD FROM (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(V.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO) DESC) AS ORDERR , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , INPT_RCP_DT , INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , CASE WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN '수입 자동 심사' ELSE '수출 자동 심사' END AS CATE , V.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD , V.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD AS AI_INSP_ATVT_STS_CD , V.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD AS AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD FROM CSPD001TM A , ( SELECT B.INPT_MST_SRNO , B.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD , B.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD , B.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO , B.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO , B.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD FROM CSPD008TH B WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '80') )V WHERE V.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('140', '160') AND TO_NUMBER(V.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) >= 80 AND AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD != '3'
UNION ALL
SELECT ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(V.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO) DESC) AS ORDERR , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , INPT_RCP_DT , INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , CASE WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN '수입 수기 심사' ELSE '수출 수기 심사' END AS CATE , V.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD , V.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD AS AI_INSP_ATVT_STS_CD
, V.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD AS AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD
FROM CSPD001TM A , ( SELECT B.INPT_MST_SRNO , B.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD , B.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD , B.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO , B.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO , B.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD FROM CSPD008TH B WHERE EXISTS( SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '80') )V WHERE V.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('140', '160') AND TO_NUMBER(V.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) >= 80 AND AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD != '3'
UNION ALL
SELECT ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(V.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO) DESC) AS ORDERR , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , INPT_RCP_DT , '3' AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , CASE WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN 'QA 자체점검(수출)' ELSE 'QA 자체점검(수입)' END AS CATE , V.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD , V.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD AS AI_INSP_ATVT_STS_CD , V.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD AS AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD FROM CSPD001TM A , (SELECT DISTINCT INPT_MST_SRNO , AI_INPT_ACVT_CD , AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD , AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO , AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO , AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD FROM CSPD008TH WHERE AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3' )V WHERE V.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('140', '160') ) GROUP BY INPT_MST_SRNO, INPT_RCP_DT, INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, CATE, AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD )M , CSPD101TI U ,( SELECT SUM( (select (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REPLACE(LST_DB_CHG_DTM ,'-',''),1,14),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REPLACE(AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM,'-',''),1,14),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) * 24 * 60 * 60 AS vsec from dual) ) AS PRO_TIME , INPT_MST_SRNO , AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO AS AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO , B.INPT_RCP_DT , AI_INPT_ACVT_CD , AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD
FROM( select ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.INPT_MST_SRNO) NUM , A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM , A.AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM AS AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM , CASE WHEN (A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD != '3' OR A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD IS NULL) AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN('51', '52', '120', '140', '160') AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '100' THEN MAS.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO WHEN (A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD != '3' OR A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD IS NULL) AND (A.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN('51', '52', '90', '100') AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN('90', '80')) THEN MAS.AI_INSPE_ENO WHEN A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3' AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN ('51', '52', '120', '140', '160') AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '120' THEN MAS.QLAS_SNPE_ENO WHEN A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = '3' AND (A.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD IN('51', '52', '90', '100') AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD = '110') THEN MAS.QLAS_CRPE_ENO ELSE 'NOT' END AS AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , MAS.INPT_RCP_DT , MAS.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD , NVL(A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD, MAS.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD) AS AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD , A.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO from CSPD008TH A , CSPD001TM MAS WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = MAS.INPT_MST_SRNO AND TO_NUMBER(A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) >= 80 )B WHERE AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('140', '160') AND AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO != 'NOT' GROUP BY INPT_MST_SRNO, AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO, B.INPT_RCP_DT, AI_INPT_ACVT_CD, AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD )TM WHERE TM.INPT_MST_SRNO = M.INPT_MST_SRNO AND TM.INPT_RCP_DT = M.INPT_RCP_DT AND U.AI_INPT_USER_ID = TM.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO AND TM.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = M.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AND M.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1}, '-', '')
GROUP BY M.CATE, M.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, M.INPT_RCP_DT, TM.PRO_TIME, TM.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO, M.INPT_MST_SRNO , U.AI_INPT_USER_NM , U.AI_INPT_AUT_CD, U.AI_INPT_USER_ENO )
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT NVL(CATE,'총합계') AS CATE , INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD , INPT_RCP_DT , AUTH , AI_INPT_AUT_CD , USER_ID , AI_INPT_USER_NM , CASE WHEN INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD IS NOT NULL THEN SUM(COUNT_ENO) OVER (PARTITION BY CATE, INPT_RCP_DT, USER_ID) ELSE SUM(COUNT_ENO) END COUNT_ENO , CASE WHEN INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR('0000'||FLOOR(FLOOR(ROUND(NVL(SUM(TOTAL_TIME) OVER(PARTITION BY CATE, INPT_RCP_DT, USER_ID),0)) / 60) / 60),-4,4)||':' ||SUBSTR('0'||MOD(FLOOR(ROUND(NVL(SUM(TOTAL_TIME) OVER(PARTITION BY CATE, INPT_RCP_DT, USER_ID),0)) / 60),60),-2,2)||':' ||SUBSTR('0'||MOD(ROUND(NVL(SUM(TOTAL_TIME) OVER(PARTITION BY CATE, INPT_RCP_DT, USER_ID),0)),60),-2,2) ELSE CASE WHEN LENGTH('0000'||FLOOR(FLOOR(ROUND(NVL(SUM(TOTAL_TIME),0)) / 60) / 60)) >= 9 THEN FLOOR(FLOOR(ROUND(NVL(SUM(TOTAL_TIME),0)) / 60) / 60)||':' ||SUBSTR('0'||MOD(FLOOR(ROUND(NVL(SUM(TOTAL_TIME),0)) / 60),60),-2,2)||':' ||SUBSTR('0'||MOD(ROUND(NVL(SUM(TOTAL_TIME),0)),60),-2,2) ELSE SUBSTR('0000'||FLOOR(FLOOR(ROUND(NVL(SUM(TOTAL_TIME),0)) / 60) / 60),-4,4)||':' ||SUBSTR('0'||MOD(FLOOR(ROUND(NVL(SUM(TOTAL_TIME),0)) / 60),60),-2,2)||':' ||SUBSTR('0'||MOD(ROUND(NVL(SUM(TOTAL_TIME),0)),60),-2,2) END END TOTAL_TIME
, CASE WHEN INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR('0000'||FLOOR(FLOOR(ROUND(NVL((SUM(TOTAL_TIME) OVER(PARTITION BY CATE, INPT_RCP_DT, USER_ID) / SUM(COUNT_ENO) OVER (PARTITION BY CATE, INPT_RCP_DT, USER_ID)),0)) / 60) / 60),-4,4)||':' ||SUBSTR('0'||MOD(FLOOR(ROUND(NVL((SUM(TOTAL_TIME) OVER(PARTITION BY CATE, INPT_RCP_DT, USER_ID) / SUM(COUNT_ENO) OVER (PARTITION BY CATE, INPT_RCP_DT, USER_ID)),0)) / 60),60),-2,2)||':' ||SUBSTR('0'||MOD(ROUND(NVL((SUM(TOTAL_TIME) OVER(PARTITION BY CATE, INPT_RCP_DT, USER_ID) / SUM(COUNT_ENO) OVER (PARTITION BY CATE, INPT_RCP_DT, USER_ID)),0)),60),-2,2) ELSE NULL END AVG_TIME , SUM(TOTAL_TIME) OVER(PARTITION BY CATE, INPT_RCP_DT, USER_ID) / SUM(COUNT_ENO) OVER (PARTITION BY CATE, INPT_RCP_DT, USER_ID) AS AVGE FROM LIST GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CATE, INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, INPT_RCP_DT, AUTH, AI_INPT_AUT_CD, USER_ID, AI_INPT_USER_NM, COUNT_ENO, TOTAL_TIME, AVG_TIME, AVGE, INPT_MST_SRNO),()) )MASTER GROUP BY CATE, INPT_RCP_DT, USER_ID ,INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, AUTH, AI_INPT_AUT_CD, AI_INPT_USER_NM, COUNT_ENO, TOTAL_TIME, AVG_TIME, AVGE ORDER BY CASE WHEN CATE = '총합계' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC, CATE DESC, INPT_RCP_DT
, CASE WHEN AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '01' THEN 0 WHEN AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '03' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
, AUTH
, AUTH DESC
, USER_ID
, USER_ID DESC
, COUNT_ENO
, COUNT_ENO DESC
, AVG_TIME
, AVG_TIME DESC
, TOTAL_TIME
, TOTAL_TIME DESC
